description: Defines the SavedVariable class used for storing snapshots of variables in autograd, including methods for reconstruction, hooks, and metadata management.

classes.name: SavedVariable
classes.description: A class representing a snapshot of a variable at a specific version, capable of reconstructing the variable and managing hooks and metadata.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Reconstructs the saved variable, optionally using a gradient function to avoid circular references.

methods.name: register_hooks
methods.description: Registers hooks for the saved variable.

methods.name: reset_data
methods.description: Resets the stored data of the saved variable.

methods.name: get_raw_data
methods.description: Returns the raw tensor data if no hooks are registered.

methods.name: retrieve_unpack_hook_data
methods.description: Retrieves hook data used during unpacking, mainly for autograd.
